title: Hivo
oneLiner: Consumer health companion — reminders, streaks, and calm UX for daily habits.

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: Users needed a lightweight way to track wellness habits without the noise of generic habit apps. Onboarding had to be under 60 seconds and work offline-first for spotty connectivity.

myRole.heading: My role
myRole.description: Sole product engineer: mobile app architecture, API design, App Store release pipeline, analytics hooks, and iterative UX based on early tester feedback.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.description: Shipped a focused React Native client with local-first sync, push notifications for streaks, and a minimal Node API for account backup. Prioritized performance and battery impact over feature breadth.

impact.heading: Impact
metrics: 500+ downloads in the first month after launch
4.6+ average rating from early adopters in soft launch regions
Sub-200ms cold start on mid-range Android devices after profiling
impact.description: Validated product–market fit signals before scaling marketing spend; retention cohorts informed the next roadmap slice.
